submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE native 1254x1254 transparent RGBA game sprite, water dragon scholar boy WEST facing screen LEFT. Image 1 is W03 corrected-foot key pose/edit target; image 2 is definitive identity for details; image 3 is approved PRIMARY bright clean rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted finish. Preserve image1's head size, camera, framing, exact planted boot locations and LEFT-pointing toes, costume, ornaments and continuous arm ownership; redraw joints only as needed for the phase. Do not mirror, recenter or zoom.
In this WEST view anatomical LEFT is the near side. Large near shoulder, foreground sleeve and EMPTY left hand form one continuous arm. Far RIGHT shoulder is partly behind chest, with right forearm and right hand gripping fan pivot on screen-left side of chest. Keep the fan ONLY in that far right hand. Large jade pendant stays on near LEFT hip, small bead/tassel stays with fan handle. Exactly 2 arms/hands/legs/boots, readable fingers/ankles. Nose always screen LEFT.
Identity: navy straight layered hair/small ponytail, turquoise-gold ornament/blue tassel, large blue eye when open, blue/ivory/gold robe with cloud-wave motifs, one ivory-blue dragon folding fan. Keep full subject within canvas, genuine transparent alpha, no shadow/floor/text/UI/effects/blood/particles/trails/blur.

Target phase 05/06 RECOVERY. Return to nearly upright torso, only 3 degrees backward tilt; both knees almost straighten while same boot positions and leftward toe orientations remain. Head centered naturally over pelvis, eye fully open blue and alert, closed mouth. Near LEFT EMPTY arm drops beside torso with relaxed fingers near hip, not spread outward. Far RIGHT hand still grips fan pivot securely at chest guard height, elbow relaxed closer to ribs. Preserve this arm assignment when lowering empty arm. Large jade remains near left hip. Hem and tassel swing much smaller, clothes settling. Clearly more upright than W03; no deep squat and no pained closed eye.
